calls.thesis: Uninspiring mid-single-digit growth outlook through 2030, but stock trades at cheapest valuation in years (11.3x fwd PE); ~68% upside over 12-18 months on his DCF.
calls.bull: Cost cuts fund R&D; AI lifts drug-development ROI; ROIC 37% (3-4x WACC) stabilizes.
calls.bear: ROIC has fallen from 80-90% over a decade; lowest R&D spend among peers (15.7%); patent loss pressures weight-loss franchise; he prefers LLY.
